subject: Superintendent Self-Evaluation
overview: The Medford School Committee met to receive the superintendent's annual self-evaluation and convened in executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy.

items.title: Superintendent's Self-Evaluation Presentation
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent presented her 2021–2022 self-evaluation, highlighting district progress in student learning, early literacy programs, equity initiatives, and professional practice goals.

items.title: Executive Session on Collective Bargaining
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to conduct strategy sessions regarding ongoing collective bargaining negotiations with nine labor unions.

items.title: Moment of Silence
items.summary: Upon returning from executive session, the committee observed a moment of silence for victims and families affected by events in Texas.
